title: Cistanche attenuates acute kidney injury by inhibiting ferroptosis through the disruption of Keap1-Nrf2 interaction.
authors: Xian, Jiayue; Wang, Siyi; Wang, Jiankun; Cao, Yiwen; Yuan, Shengliang; Zhou, Jiuyao; Zhou, Yuan
one_liner_zh: 研究中药肉苁蓉通过破坏Keap1-Nrf2蛋白互作抑制铁死亡保护急性肾损伤，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作和分子对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，方法仅简单分子对接，与TF-DNA课题关联弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Ferroptosis, an iron-dependent regulated cell death, critically contributes to acute kidney injury (AKI) progression. Emerging evidence suggests ferroptosis inhibition as a therapeutic strategy against AKI. Cistanche (Cis), a kidney-tonifying herb in traditional Chinese medicine, exhibits antioxidant activity via nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) activation. However, the precise molecular mechanism underlying cistanche-mediated Nrf2 activation remains undefined, and its nephroprotective potential in AKI is incompletely characterized. AIM OF THE STUDY: To investigate the renoprotective effects of cistanche against AKI and elucidate its mechanism through the Keap1-Nrf2-ferroptosis axis. MATERIALS AND METHODS: An ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI)-induced AKI mouse model and a hypoxia-reoxygenation-induced mRTEC cell model were constructed to evaluate the protective effects of cistanche. First, cistanche (2.055, 4.110 and 8.220 g/kg), and saline were administered for 6 days. On the 5th day, the mice were anesthetized and then bilateral renal artery clamping was performed for 45 min. Mice in the sham-operated group underwent the same operation but no arterial clamping was performed. Until 24 h after the IRI procedure, all mice were anesthetized, then blood samples and kidney tissue were collected. Subsequently, Nrf2 knockout mRTEC cells were used to verify whether Nrf2 mediated the nephroprotective effects of cistanche. Furthermore, the effect of cistanche on Keap1-Nrf2 protein-protein interaction (PPI) in the kidney of IRI mice was verified by CO-IP assay. Finally, UPLC-Q-TOF/MS technique and molecular docking were utilized to analyze the potential pharmacological components of cistanche. RESULTS: In vivo, cistanche treatment improved renal function in IRI mice, as shown by decreased serum creatinine (SCr), blood urea nitrogen (BUN), inflammatory factors, and renal injury markers (NGAL, KIM-1), along with ameliorated ferroptosis-related abnormalities. In vitro, cistanche suppressed ferroptosis in hypoxia-reoxygenation-induced HK2 cells by activating Nrf2, an effect that was significantly diminished upon Nrf2 silencing in mRTEC cells. Mechanistically, cistanche facilitated Nrf2 nuclear translocation and inhibited ferroptosis, likely by disrupting the Keap1-Nrf2 protein-protein interaction. Furthermore, UPLC-Q/TOF-MS analysis identified key bioactive components in cistanche that may contribute to its anti-ferroptosis effects. CONCLUSION: Overall, cistanche functions as a putative Keap1-Nrf2 PPI inhibitor primarily through its phenylethanoid glycosides. By disrupting Keap1-Nrf2 binding, it activates Nrf2 signaling, suppresses ferroptosis, and confers protection against AKI, positioning it as a promising therapeutic candidate.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种铁依赖性调节性细胞死亡，在急性肾损伤（AKI）进展中起关键作用。新出现的证据表明，抑制铁死亡可作为对抗AKI的治疗策略。肉苁蓉（Cis）是传统中药中的补肾草药，通过核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）激活表现出抗氧化活性。然而，肉苁蓉介导的Nrf2激活的精确分子机制仍未明确，其在AKI中的肾脏保护潜力尚未完全表征。研究目的：探讨肉苁蓉对AKI的肾脏保护作用，并通过Keap1-Nrf2-铁死亡轴阐明其机制。材料与方法：构建缺血再灌注损伤（IRI）诱导的AKI小鼠模型和缺氧复氧诱导的mRTEC细胞模型，以评估肉苁蓉的保护作用。首先，给予肉苁蓉（2.055、4.110和8.220 g/kg）和生理盐水处理6天。第5天，小鼠被麻醉，然后进行双侧肾动脉夹闭45分钟。假手术组小鼠接受相同手术但不进行动脉夹闭。IRI程序后24小时，所有小鼠被麻醉，然后收集血样和肾组织。随后，使用Nrf2敲除的mRTEC细胞验证Nrf2是否介导肉苁蓉的肾脏保护作用。此外，通过CO-IP实验验证肉苁蓉对IRI小鼠肾脏中Keap1-Nrf2蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）的影响。最后，利用UPLC-Q-TOF/MS技术和分子对接分析肉苁蓉的潜在药理成分。结果：在体内，肉苁蓉处理改善了IRI小鼠的肾功能，表现为血清肌酐（SCr）、血尿素氮（BUN）、炎症因子和肾损伤标志物（NGAL、KIM-1）降低，同时改善了铁死亡相关异常。在体外，肉苁蓉通过激活Nrf2抑制缺氧复氧诱导的HK2细胞中的铁死亡，而在mRTEC细胞中Nrf2沉默后该效应显著减弱。机制上，肉苁蓉促进Nrf2核转位并抑制铁死亡，可能通过破坏Keap1-Nrf2蛋白-蛋白相互作用实现。此外，UPLC-Q/TOF-MS分析鉴定了肉苁蓉中可能有助于其抗铁死亡作用的关键生物活性成分。结论：总体而言，肉苁蓉主要通过其苯乙醇苷类化合物作为推定的Keap1-Nrf2 PPI抑制剂。通过破坏Keap1-Nrf2结合，它激活Nrf2信号通路，抑制铁死亡，并对AKI提供保护，使其成为有前景的治疗候选药物。
